1533:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c."customerid",
    y."consumption" AS consumption_status
FROM
    "transactions_1k" t
JOIN
    "customers" c ON t."customerid" = c."customerid"
LEFT JOIN
    "yearmonth" y ON c."customerid" = y."customerid"
    AND y."date" = '201208'
WHERE
    t."productid" = 5
    AND (t."price" / NULLIF(t."amount", 0)) > 29.00;
180:
SELECT DISTINCT c."client_id"
FROM "client" c
JOIN "disp" d ON c."client_id" = d."client_id"
JOIN "account" a ON d."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "district" dist ON a."district_id" = dist."district_id"
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c."birth_date"::DATE) BETWEEN 1983 AND 1987
  AND dist."a3" = 'east bohemia';
685:
SELECT
    p."viewcount" AS total_views,
    u."displayname" AS user_who_posted_last
FROM
    "posts" p
JOIN
    "users" u ON p."owneruserid" = u."id"
WHERE
    p."title" = 'Computer Game Datasets'
    AND p."posttypeid" = 1  
ORDER BY
    p."creationdate" DESC
LIMIT 1;
1339:
SELECT AVG(e."cost") AS average_cost
FROM "expense" e
JOIN "member" m ON e."link_to_member" = m."member_id"
WHERE m."first_name" = 'Elijah'
  AND m."last_name" = 'Allen'
  AND (SUBSTRING(e."expense_date", 6, 2) = '09' OR SUBSTRING(e."expense_date", 6, 2) = '10');
